instruction: Change the permissions of all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory tree that were last modified 30 days ago to read-only (444)

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'OLD_RO=$(find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f -perm 444 2>/dev/null | wc -l); NEW_RW=$(find /tmp/test_files/new_files -type f -perm -200 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$OLD_RO" -eq 2 ] && [ "$NEW_RW" -eq 2 ]; then echo "Success: Old files set to read-only, new files remain writable"; else echo "Fail: OLD_RO=$OLD_RO NEW_RW=$NEW_RW"; fi'

include: Success: Old files set to read-only, new files remain writable

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing permissions of old files (30+ days) to read-only (444) while preserving new files' writable permissions. Verification checks that 2 files in old_files have permission 444 and 2 files in new_files remain writable (have write permission). Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator assumes hardcoded directory structure (/tmp/test_files/old_files and /tmp/test_files/new_files) that is not specified in the instruction
Does not verify the actual requirement: files modified 30 days ago. Instead relies on indirect assumption that files in 'old_files' directory are 30+ days old
Uses hardcoded file count (exactly 2 old files, exactly 2 new files) instead of verifying 'all files' as stated in instruction
Missing verification that file selection was based on modification time - the core requirement of the task
Evaluator only checks subset of files in specific subdirectories, not 'all files in the directory tree' as required
Logic gap: doesn't verify files outside old_files/new_files subdirectories were handled correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Use 'find /tmp/test_files -type f -mtime +30' to identify files actually modified 30+ days ago, not rely on directory structure
Verify permissions on ALL files found by the time-based query, not hardcoded count of 2
Add verification that files modified less than 30 days ago retain their original permissions
Remove hardcoded directory structure assumptions (old_files/new_files) and work with actual file timestamps
Use dynamic count validation: check that all files matching the time criterion have permission 444
